chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
When you have eaten something, lie down on your back and place your right leg upon the left.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended posture for resting after eating according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Transmitted through the chain of the Imams, this hadith from Al-Kafi prescribes a specific postprandial posture of reclining on the back with the right leg crossed over the left, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of moderation and physical ease after eating. In Shia scholarly tradition, this practice is often linked to facilitating digestion and maintaining a state of calm repose, embodying the balance between bodily care and spiritual mindfulness.
